note: Document- and lineage-level identity for the COVID corpus. Keys are canonical source URLs. lineage_id groups documents that draw on the same underlying generative event, which is the level at which independence must be counted.

wilf-miller-debate-2024-02.label: Wilf–Miller COVID origins debate (Feb 2024)
wilf-miller-debate-2024-02.description: A single 15-hour structured debate. Judgments of it, participant post-mortems, and observer reviews all take this one event as their input. They are not independent observations of COVID origins; they are independent readings of one shared record.

weissman-bayesian-analysis-2024.label: Weissman independent Bayesian analysis
weissman-bayesian-analysis-2024.description: An analytical artifact reasoning over the public genomic and epidemiological record rather than over the debate. Independent of the debate lineage, but note that Judge Will's computation explicitly derives from this method.

acx-bayes-estimate-collection-2024.description: One collection event. The '23 orders of magnitude' figure traces here. Any document repeating that figure is repeating this single datum, not corroborating it.

doctrine-labs-inference.label: Doctrine Labs agent inference
doctrine-labs-inference.description: Hypotheses generated by this tool. Never evidence; included so they are visible and separable.
